name: Link title formatter
description: Field formatter that renders a link field's title as plain, escaped text without the anchor.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Introduction 
 The link title formatter module allows you to just display the link title field without the link. This module is useful when we use UI Patterns to display the link as a button, which accepts two separate fields to render the button (URL & Label).

 You can use the Display Copy Field module to make a copy of the link field. Use one field for rendering just the URL and use the copy field for displaying just the link title. 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 This module requires no additional contrib modules.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 Install as usual as per http://drupal.org/node/895232 .

 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 The module has no menu or modifiable settings. Configuration is done on a field by field

basis on the Manage display page by selecting the *Link Title Text* formatter for any link field.

 Back to top
